summary: Frontend-only testing of iter288 messaging audit fixes (MSG08/MSG09/MSG10) + regression of /admin/deliveries. All target selectors and behaviors verified green. Seed data created with ta288_ prefix and cleaned up.

issues: Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to DeliveryChatDialog and other DialogContent without one to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: CourierPanel.jsx: SSE useLiveEvent + 30s interval + visibilitychange combined correctly with stable load() via useCallback — race-safe.
DeliveryChatDialog.jsx: genRef invalidation correctly discards in-flight responses when deliveryId changes — verified end-to-end (no A↔B leak).
deliveryEta.js LOCATION_MAX_AGE_MIN=15 works; DeliveryTrackCard renders data-testid=track-stale-<id>; AdminDeliveries renders data-testid=admin-eta-stale-<id>.
test_credentials: Cookies session_token=test_session_vip_X (user_test_vip01, is_courier=true) and test_session_admin_X (user_test_admin01) on preview domain.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 3 deliveries (ta288_mineA, ta288_mineB on_the_way with courier_id=user_test_vip01; ta288_stale on_the_way with client=vip, courier=admin, courier_location.updated_at = 24h ago) and 2 delivery_chat rows (MSG_FROM_A_ONLY, MSG_FROM_B_ONLY). ALL cleaned up (delete_many by prefix ta288_ → 3 + 3 removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter288 messaging audit frontend fixes verified green. No blocking issues. Preview URL: https://p2p-exchange-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Notes: (a) direct Mongo inserts do NOT emit SSE — rely on 30s polling / visibilitychange; (b) cookie domain must be exact: p2p-exchange-hub-2.preview.emergentagent.com; (c) NEVER wait_until='networkidle' on /dashboard/deliveries (SSE stream keeps it open).

detailed_results.MSG10_panel: PASS — data-testid=courier-panel; courier-earned-total, courier-pending-total, courier-completed-count all visible; tabs available/mine/history all present and navigable; no eternal spinner and no error state.
detailed_results.MSG10_refresh_polling: PASS — visibilitychange dispatch kept panel responsive; code review confirms 30s interval + SSE 'delivery_changed' listener + visibilitychange handler all wired via stable useCallback load().
detailed_results.MSG10_error_retry: Not forced. No eternal spinner observed under valid session.
detailed_results.MSG09_chat_isolation: PASS — chat A shows only MSG_FROM_A_ONLY; chat B shows only MSG_FROM_B_ONLY; sending via delivery-chat-input + delivery-chat-send-btn appended message immediately.
